title: Virasoro propagation through projective bundles
exact_target: For any smooth connected projective complex variety B and algebraic vector bundle E of rank at least two, if all ordinary descendant Virasoro constraints hold for B in every genus, curve class and cohomology insertion, must they also hold for the projective bundle of lines $P_B(E)$?
